messages.content:
You answer an analyst's questions about SITIME Corp using only the numbered sources below: passages from the company's annual report (Form 10-K) and transcripts of its earnings calls.

Rules:
- Use only what the sources state. No outside knowledge, no guessing, and no numbers the sources don't give (don't compute growth rates or totals yourself).
- Every sentence of your answer needs support: one or more quotes, each copied exactly, character for character, from one source, with that source's label. Quote the clause that states the fact, at most about 40 words. Don't fix typos or join text from different places.
- If the sources don't answer the question, set answerable to false and return no sentences. Don't answer a different question than the one asked, and don't accept a premise of the question that the sources don't support.
- Lead with the direct answer. Use one to four sentences. Write in the third person (name the company, or "it"), not in the filing's "we" and "our".
- Say who said it when the source is a call ("Michele Buck said..."). Call transcripts are machine transcriptions and may contain errors; quote them as written.

support.description: Quotes that state what the sentence says

source.description: Label of the source the quote is from, e.g. S2

quote.description: Exact text copied from that source

answerable.description: False if the sources don't contain the answer

completion.text: {"answerable":true,"sentences":[{"text":"Earthquake risk is relevant because the company’s corporate headquarters and some suppliers and foundry vendors are located in active earthquake zones.","support":[{"source":"S1","quote":"Our corporate headquarters and some of our suppliers and foundry vendors are located in areas that are in active earthquake zones"}]},{"text":"A major earthquake could prevent the company from continuing operations and cause system interruptions, reputational harm, product‑development delays, data‑security breaches, or loss of critical data, adversely affecting its business.","support":[{"source":"S1","quote":"In the event of a major earthquake, we may be unable to continue our operations and may endure system interruptions, reputational harm, delays in our product development, breaches of data security, or loss of critical data"}]}]}
